flux.name: AceData_Flux_Image_Studio
flux.brief: Flux AI image generation and editing
flux.about:
Generate and edit product photos, illustrations and social visuals with Flux. Describe a new image, or provide an image URL and describe the changes you want. The tool returns ready-to-use image links.

Setup: create an Ace Data Cloud account and API token at https://platform.acedata.cloud/?from=coze
Bind Authorization privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in your workflow. Never put a real token in chat or shared examples. Usage is charged to your own Ace Data Cloud account.

Default model: Flux 2 Pro. Default aspect ratio: 1:1. Both generation and image editing have been verified with real outputs.
flux.scenarios:
E-commerce teams: create clean product visuals from a description, then change backgrounds while preserving the product.
Social media creators: turn a campaign idea into square promotional imagery for posts and thumbnails.
Designers and workflow builders: automate image generation and pass the returned image URL to the next step.

seedream.name: AceData_Seedream_Images
seedream.brief: Seedream AI product images and illustrations
seedream.about:
Create product visuals, social posts and illustrations from a text description with Seedream. Choose the subject, style and composition; receive a generated image link ready to use in your Coze workflow.

Setup: create an Ace Data Cloud account and API token at https://platform.acedata.cloud/?from=coze
Bind Authorization privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN. Never put a real token in chat or shared examples. Usage is charged to your own Ace Data Cloud account.

Default model: Seedream 5.0 Lite. Default image resolution: 2K. Real 2048 x 2048 image generation has been verified.
seedream.scenarios:
E-commerce teams: create product concept visuals and clean catalog backgrounds from a short creative brief.
Content creators: produce illustrations for posts, articles and campaign drafts.
Workflow builders: generate an image automatically and pass its URL to later content-production steps.

serp.name: AceData_Google_Web_Search
serp.brief: Google web search with sources and filters
serp.about:
Search the web with Google and receive ranked titles, source links and snippets. Filter results by country, language or recency and use pagination for focused research.

Setup: create an Ace Data Cloud account and API token at https://platform.acedata.cloud/?from=coze
Bind Authorization privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN. Never put a real token in chat or shared examples. Usage is charged to your own Ace Data Cloud account.

Use returned source links in answers. A search snippet is a starting point for verification, not the full page.
serp.scenarios:
Researchers and analysts: gather current sources for a topic and verify claims against the returned pages.
Content teams: find relevant references before writing an article or preparing a briefing.
Workflow builders: add localized, time-filtered web research to an agent or automated workflow.

shorturl.name: AceData_Short_Links
shorturl.brief: Create compact links for sharing and campaigns
shorturl.about:
Turn a long public URL into a compact shareable link. Use it in messages, campaigns and automated Coze workflows; the tool returns the actual short URL in data.url.

Setup: create an Ace Data Cloud account and API token at https://platform.acedata.cloud/?from=coze
Bind Authorization privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN. Never put a real token in chat or shared examples. Usage is charged according to your Ace Data Cloud account.

Only submit URLs intended for sharing. Do not include passwords, tokens or private information in a URL.
shorturl.scenarios:
Marketing teams: shorten a campaign landing-page URL before sharing it in a post or message.
Support and community teams: turn a long public documentation link into an easier-to-share URL.
Workflow builders: generate a short link automatically and insert it into the next publishing or messaging step.
